_comment: Which node inputs Shotlist fills in workflows/shotlist.json. 'from' is one of: image, prompt, frames, fps, width, height, seed, duration, camera.move, camera.zoomStart, camera.zoomEnd, camera.panX, camera.panY, camera.roll. 'lookup' maps a value (e.g. a move id) to what the node needs; 'default' is used when the value is missing or not in the lookup.
